thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate detected on infer-gateway-usw2 — ~12% 500s and timeouts across /v1/generate and /v1/chat in the last 3m. Pager routed to @oncall_sre. 
oncall_sre: I’m on it, starting logs + metrics pull. 
runtime_lead: Seeing SIGSEGVs in model-runner pods (infer-runner-12/13). Pattern: OOM then segfault on GPU node gca-usw2-23. Root cause unclear yet. 
ops_kevin: Initiating traffic diversion: shift 80-90% of traffic from us-west-2 to eu-west-1/us-east-1 to reduce blast radius. Will report when done. :rotating_light: 
oncall_sre: Reroute applied, DNS backends updated, load now ~15% on usw2. Error rate dropped to ~4.5%. 
eng_maria: Can someone grab the container + dmesg logs from infer-runner-12? Need stack traces. 
runtime_lead: Logs snippet copied below:
```
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] infer-runner-12: malloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] infer-runner-12: signal 11 (SEGV) at 0x7f2c1a2b
stack: model_runner::attention::kernel_dispatch +0x1b4
[2026-03-16T14:02:11Z] GPU(0): meminfo: free 1200MB / total 24576MB
```
eng_maria: That looks like a KV cache growth path — sequences >4k pushed the cache above allocator quota on the quantized kernel. 
runtime_lead: Hypothesis: q4_0 attention kernel triggers unbounded auxiliary allocation for long streaming sequences, then OOM -> segfault. Will test a fallback to fp16. 
ops_kevin: Preparing a controlled rollback: disable q4_0 quant profile for affected model-group and force fp16 variant on new pods. Increasing fallback pool by 3x to absorb traffic. 
oncall_sre: Patch applied, new pods rolled. Health checks green. Observability shows error rate on /v1/generate down to 0.8% and latency normalized. :white_check_mark: 
product_safe: Customer impact summary? Which tenants hit failures? 
billing_bot: Telemetry: 12 customers had >=2 failed requests during spike window, largest by request volume were: acme-ads (streaming), data-sci-inc (long-context ingestion). Failure mode: 500 / request timeout. No billing spikes. 
eng_maria: Action items: 1) Add guardrails to KV cache growth (quota + early-evict), 2) Add canary tests with long sequences for quant profiles, 3) Add runtime sentinel to fail-fast when auxiliary_alloc > X, 4) Add tooling to detect quant kernel regressions on canary models. 
oncall_sre: I'll keep pager open for 2 hours for stability checks; if stable, hand off to eng for RCA tomorrow morning. 
runtime_lead: We'll produce a post-incident RFC with root cause, timeline, and mitigation plan (kernel patch + test coverage). Planning to backport hotfix to dedicated pools. 
incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated — pager cleared.
